name: Simon Iscariot
title: Judas Iscariot's father
summary: Simon Iscariot is known only from the Bible as the father of Judas Iscariot, the disciple who betrayed Jesus. His surname 'Iscariot' may mean 'man from Kerioth', a town in Judea, which would make his family the only non-Galilean among the twelve apostles.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned as Judas's father
keyEvents.description: Simon Iscariot is mentioned in the Gospel of John as the father of Judas, in connection with Jesus knowing who would betray him.

keyEvents.title: Referred to at the Last Supper
keyEvents.description: At the Last Supper, Judas is again referred to as 'the son of Simon Iscariot', since the devil had put it into his heart to betray Jesus.
